content.title: History of the Conflict between Religion and Science (1874)
content.author: John William Draper
content.role: Primary record · not a teaching authority
content.note: The book that launched the 'conflict thesis' in English: science as the expansive human intellect, religion as compression from tradition. Cited as a primary record of the thesis, which historians of science now reject, not as reliable history. Public domain.
